issues.quote: Total assets stood at $619.0 million at the end of fiscal 2025
issues.problem: The unit is wrong. Microsoft's total assets at June 30, 2025 were about $619.0 billion, not million. That is off by a factor of 1,000.

data.summary: Revenue ($281.7B vs. $245.1B, +14.9%), net income ($101.8B), operating income ($128.5B), and cash and cash equivalents (~$30.2B) all match what I know of Microsoft's FY2025 results. Total assets are wrong, though: the analysis says $619.0 million when the figure is about $619.0 billion. The text's own note to record the figure as $619.0 billion matches the correct value.
